versions.name: Camp O'Rear
versions.summary: A 90-acre primitive-style Black Warrior Council camp near Jasper, Alabama, owned and operated by the council along Black Water Creek, with a small dining hall, a troop lodge, a large creekside pavilion, and a swinging bridge amid diverse Alabama woodland.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Black Warrior Council's own Facilities page, which describes Camp O'Rear as council-owned and operated. Coordinates geocoded via US Census (exact); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.
